$comment: The Antigravity models the window's pickers offer, each with the levels `agy` accepts for `--effort` (null: the model takes no effort). agentSelection.ts reads this file for the pickers; live_antigravity_model_table_matches_the_cli_model_list (desktop/src-tauri/src/antigravity_models.rs) compares it with `agy --output-format json models`, so a model Google adds, retires or re-levels fails `make test-live-antigravity`. The list is the signed-in account's (Business and Google Cloud sign-ins can hide Claude models), so before deleting a model the test reports missing, confirm it is gone: dispatch it bare, `agy -p ack --model <id>` without `--effort`, which reports `not recognized as a known model` (with `--effort` agy misreports an unknown model as `--effort is not supported`), or check from a second account. Matches agy 1.4.2 (2026-10-19). Labels drop agy's `Claude ` prefix; see MODEL_OPTIONS in agentSelection.ts.
